items: ANY PARENTAL CONTROL APP- Empower yourself. Our smartphone can use any parental control app. Monitor, manage, and guide your child’s device usage effectively. Ensure their safety and foster responsible usage. Compatible with Google Family Link, Bark, Qustodio, Norton Family, and more. It’s not just a phone; it’s your peace of mind.

SHINE BRIGHT WITH A 6.7" 1600 x 720 DISPLAY- The 90Hz refresh rate delivers smooth, vibrant visuals for every moment. Enjoy streaming, calling, texting, and casual gaming all day without worries. This unlocked Android phone's battery keeps you connected and entertained, just like you did with your friends.

EFFORTLESS IN EVERY SHOT- Capture Every Precious Moment in a Flash With the 50MP Main, 8MP Selfie and 2MP Macro. It's an Affordable Mobile Phone and the Gateway to Creating Vivid Memories and Lifelong Friendships. Snap, Blur, and Sharpen Those Unforgettable Moments to Keep the BFF Memories Alive.

POWER THAT LASTS ALL DAY- Powered by an octa-core MediaTek Helio G81 2.0GHz and 6GB RAM with 6GB virtual RAM (6+6 total max 12GB), it strikes the perfect balance for every need. The fast fingerprint unlock feature enhances privacy. We include a clear TPU transparent case and an 18W fast charger brick, which allows you to charge the 5000mAh battery from 30% to 79% in just 39 minutes.

PLENTY OF STORAGE- With 128GB of storage, your teen can take control of their digital life, storing all their favorite photos, music, videos, and apps directly on their device. And if that's not enough, they can expand their storage up to an additional 256GB with a microSD card (not included). Encourage them to capture every moment, download every song, and watch every video without relying on expensive cloud services. This phone is the perfect companion for their journey to unforgettable experiences.

MAJOR CARRIERS SUPPORTED - Compatible with T-Mobile, Mint Mobile, Metro, Q Link Wireless, Google Fi, Hello Mobile, Tello Mobile, Lycamobile, Patriot Mobile, Republic Wireless, Simple Mobile, StandUp Wireless, SpeedTalk, Telcel America, (NO SIM CARD INCLUDED) and VoLTE/HD Voice Support To Know Your Carrier Support Our Phone Let us Know Here On Amazon

NOT COMPATIBLE with Verizon, AT&T, Cricket. Boost mobile, Tracfone, Pulse Cellular, Union Wireless, Spectrum or any CDMA Carrier in the World. For more carrier information reach out our customer support.

INTERNATIONAL- Stay connected wherever you are in the world. Use Dual SIM, (Nano SIM Card) making them versatile and perfect for travel. Before you travel, please check with your destination carrier if you can "bring your Own Device" and if they use ANY of the following bands: 4G-B2/4/5/12/17/25/26/41/66/71 Please Note That Some Operators Or Carriers Needs to Configure APN.

STAY CONNECTED WITH SEAMLESS 3.5MM JACK Practical and ready to deliver, rediscover the joy of effortless audio with the 3.5mm jack. Whether you’re plugging in your favorite headphones or connecting to speakers, enjoy seamless, high-quality sound without the need for adapters. Designed to keep you connected to your music, calls, and media, just the way you like it.

Powered by Android 14 | One-Year U.S. Manufacturer | Warranty Experience a clean and seamless interface with stock Android 14—free from bloatware, pre-installed apps, or unwanted ads. Enjoy peace of mind with our one-year manufacturer warranty within the United States. If you have any questions or need assistance, simply reach out to our customer service team with your order ID. We're here to help and always happy to support you.
